d: Long, flowing espresso-brown hair with straight-cut bangs and a side-parted fringe flows around a youthful, adolescent face with vibrant sapphire-blue eyes. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a deep navy blue kimono featuring gold trim and intricate floral patterns in white, pink, and purple, worn over a short white undergarment and paired with white thigh-high stockings and traditional zori sandals. Signature details include a small red ribbon hair accessory, white bead ornaments hanging from the hair, and a long black katana with a gold guard and red tassel.
